item.description:
## More control over review fixes
Choose whether Auto Fix builds and tests after a fix, and follow adversarial review progress in the conversation. Stop interrupts more of the work in progress. Fixes check review findings before acting and explain findings that are deferred.
## Clearer test runs
Filter test runs by status, see their elapsed time, and give agents more useful details when tests fail. The test queue releases checkout holds when a timed-out process has finished.
## Smoother review and conversation navigation
Pull request selection follows the current thread, and merge status and refresh controls are clearer. The conversation stays at the bottom as streamed content and cards finish laying out.

## Work through pull request reviews
Choose an engine and model for local reviews and fixes, and run multi-engine reviews to compare findings. Review controls, progress, and status are clearer, and fix choices stay available as you move between review tabs.
## Keep conversations organized
Name and pin threads, move between them more easily, and restore composer input history. Drafts and pull request context stay with the right thread as you switch conversations.
## More reliable work on branches
Kulula now shows branch and checkout status more clearly, helps route work to the right thread, and handles review and checkout actions more reliably. Live progress and completion notifications make long-running work easier to follow.

## Review pull requests with multiple engines
Run Claude, Codex, and Antigravity against a pull request diff at the same time. Kulula brings their findings together, highlights where they agree or disagree, and can use the results to guide Auto Fix rounds. You choose which engines take part in Settings; standalone reviews remain available.
## Work through reviews more clearly
Review findings and controls are easier to follow in the review panel, with improved filtering, layout, and progress feedback. You can now choose the engine and model for review fixes and local reviews, and see clearer status when a review is running or blocked.
## More reliable conversations
Approvals and engine responses are handled more consistently, including when a turn is cancelled or an engine session is replaced. The app also checks for updates at launch and hourly.
